page.overview:
Who is M.A. Brake Drumm?

M.A. Brake Drumm is a car that is a fan of the Piston Cup Racing Series. In Cars, M.A. can be seen on Los Angeles International Speedway. She, Brake Boyd, and Coriander Widetrack watch admiringly as Marco, Stu Bop, and another jet fly over them.
